body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2006 CES') -- <Visual News>

Canon USA has released its four digital camcorder at CES 2006:ZR 500, 600,700 and Elura model. ZR series will be available at the end of this month, January 2006 while Elura will be available in February 2006.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2006 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Yoojin Kim / IKKim, Alliah Seo correspondents of AVING to CES / edited by Daniel Sirh >
